meta.purpose: Facts for the PMS vs MF vs SIF vs AIF comparison page. Educational only, not investment advice.

status_legend.official: Read directly on a SEBI or Income Tax Department page.
status_legend.official_reported: An official SEBI document exists (page confirmed), but the figure was taken from a news report quoting it.
status_legend.legal_database: Text of an Act reproduced by a tax-law database, not the government site.
status_legend.secondary: News, broker or advisory websites only. Verify before relying on it.
status_legend.not_verified: No source found. Do not present as fact.

open_items: PMS Regulations 2026 were approved by the SEBI Board on 24 Sep 2026; formal notification not confirmed.
Tax rates being unchanged for FY 2026-27 rests on secondary sources.
Mutual fund facts rest on secondary sources; SEBI's own text not read.

min_investment.label: Minimum investment
min_investment.value: SIPs start from about Rs 500. The amount is set by fund houses, not by SEBI.

regulation_status.label: Rulebook
regulation_status.value: The 2026 regulations replaced the 1996 regulations and took effect on 1 April 2026.

fees.label: Fees
fees.value: Expense ratio is capped by SEBI. Total expense ratio = base expense ratio + brokerage + statutory levies. Example base caps: 0.95% for equity-oriented schemes above Rs 50,000 crore, 0.90% for index funds and ETFs.

sources.supports: Base expense ratio structure and example caps

tax.label: Tax
tax.value: Listed equity and equity-oriented funds: long-term gains (held over 12 months) are taxed at 12.5% above Rs 1.25 lakh a year; short-term gains at 20%.

sources.supports: Long-term capital gains rate of 12.5% for transfers on or after 23 July 2024
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 text: Rs 1.25 lakh limit on long-term gains under section 112A
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 text: short-term rate of 20% on or after 23 July 2024

tax.note: Rates apply to transfers on or after 23 July 2024. Their continuation for FY 2026-27 is reported by secondary sources only.

liquidity.label: Liquidity / exit load
liquidity.value: Not verified. Varies by manager or scheme; check the offer documents.

equity_oriented.label: What counts as equity-oriented
equity_oriented.value: A fund with 65% or more of its assets in domestic equity shares is treated as equity-oriented for these rates.

sources.supports: 65% domestic equity test for equity-oriented funds

sif.name: Specialised Investment Fund (SIF)
sif.regulation: SEBI circular dated 27 Feb 2025, effective 1 April 2025

min_investment.label: Minimum investment
min_investment.value: Rs 10 lakh across all SIF strategies, counted at PAN level. Accredited investors are exempt.

sources.supports: SEBI circular page on monitoring the threshold, 29 Jul 2025
PTI report quoting the PAN-level rule

fees.label: Fees
fees.value: Not verified. Varies by manager or scheme; check the offer documents.

tax.label: Tax
tax.value: Not verified separately for SIFs. Treatment depends on the strategy and how units are taxed; check before relying on it.

pms.name: Portfolio Management Services (PMS)
pms.regulation: SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2020 (in force as far as found). New 2026 regulations approved by the SEBI Board on 24 Sep 2026; notification not confirmed.

sources.supports: PTI report of SEBI notification doubling the minimum to Rs 50 lakh

structure.label: What it is
structure.value: A SEBI-registered portfolio manager runs a customised portfolio, typically for high-net-worth clients.

regulation_status.label: Rule change pending
regulation_status.value: SEBI's Board approved new Portfolio Managers Regulations, 2026 on 24 Sep 2026. A law-firm summary says most such decisions need formal Gazette notification before taking effect. No notification found.

tax.label: Tax
tax.value: Listed equity and equity-oriented funds: long-term gains (held over 12 months) are taxed at 12.5% above Rs 1.25 lakh a year; short-term gains at 20%. Gains arise in the investor's hands trade by trade, so high-turnover strategies can produce short-term gains during the year.

sources.supports: Long-term capital gains rate of 12.5% for transfers on or after 23 July 2024
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 text: Rs 1.25 lakh limit on long-term gains under section 112A
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 text: short-term rate of 20% on or after 23 July 2024
How PMS gains accumulate during the year

fees.label: Fees
fees.value: Not verified. Varies by manager or scheme; check the offer documents.
fees.note: No SEBI cap on regular PMS fees was found. Fee structures vary by manager.

prim.name: PMS mutual-fund route (PRIM)
prim.regulation: Approved by the SEBI Board on 24 Sep 2026 as part of the Portfolio Managers Regulations, 2026. Not confirmed in force.

fees.label: Fees
fees.value: Fixed management fee capped at 1% of client assets. Performance-based fee also permitted. Exit load waived.

structure.label: What it is
structure.value: Portfolio managers invest client money only in direct plans of mutual funds, including ETFs, index funds and SIFs.

aif.name: Alternative Investment Fund (AIF)
aif.regulation: SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012 (amended up to 14 July 2026)

min_investment.label: Minimum investment per investor
min_investment.value: Rs 1 crore. Rs 25 lakh for employees or directors of the fund or its manager. Does not apply to accredited investors.
min_investment.note: Accredited investors exempt. Each scheme needs a corpus of at least Rs 20 crore.

categories.label: Categories
categories.value: Category I: start-ups, SMEs, infrastructure and similar. Category II: private equity and debt funds, no leverage beyond limits. Category III: complex or trading strategies that may use leverage.

lock_in.label: Tenure and liquidity
lock_in.value: Category I and II must be close-ended with a minimum tenure of three years. Category III can be open- or close-ended.

large_value_fund.label: Large value fund for accredited investors
large_value_fund.value: Each investor must invest at least Rs 25 crore (previously Rs 70 crore, changed with effect from 19 Nov 2025).

accredited_investor.label: Accredited investor (individual, HUF, family trust, sole proprietorship)
accredited_investor.value: Annual income of at least Rs 2 crore; or net worth of at least Rs 7.5 crore with at least Rs 3.75 crore in financial assets; or income of at least Rs 1 crore with net worth of at least Rs 5 crore (Rs 2.5 crore in financial assets). Certificate from an accreditation agency needed.
accredited_investor.note: SEBI's Board approved a manager-led route and a Rs 5 crore securities-market-exposure test on 24 Sep 2026. Not confirmed in force.

tax.label: Tax
tax.value: Category I and II AIFs generally get pass-through taxation. Category III AIFs are taxed at fund level.

tax_cat3_effective.label: Effective tax on Category III AIFs
tax_cat3_effective.value: Not verified. Varies by manager or scheme; check the offer documents.
